export_evidence: No export bill-of-lading record found. ImportKey page for slug 'beauty-concepts-private-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/beauty-concepts-private-limited) shows the company exclusively on the BUYER side of Indian customs entries. Exact line: "2026-02-23 | GRAHAME INTERNATIONAL PTE LTD | BEAUTY CONCEPTS PRIVATE LIMITED | BENTLEY - BEN FOR M ABSOLUTE EDP 100ML .- Singapore, FRANCE | KOLKATA SEA | 33030090 | BOL 7690041" — i.e. goods arriving INTO India, not leaving. The only outbound-looking row is a Hong Kong counterparty listed under the 'Buyers' block: "19 TO MS HOYING LEE BEAUTY CONCEPTS PRIVATE LIMITED, 5TH FLOOR TIN ON INDUSTRIAL BUILDING 777-779 CHEUNG SHA WAN ROAD KOWLOON HONG KONG" — this is a Hong Kong entity with a similar name, not an Indian export shipment by the Indian company; no date, no HS code, no B/L number attached, so it cannot be counted as an export record. Source counter: ImportKey reports "Total Shipments 46041 Records detected" for this company, but the free view exposes only 5 shipment rows plus 5 supplier rows and 1 buyer row (11 rows actually seen) — the 46,041 figure is a platform counter, not verified rows. Slug variants tried: 'beauty-concepts-private-limited' (data present), 'beauty-concepts-pvt-ltd' (page exists, zero records rendered), 'beauty-concepts' (page exists, zero records rendered). volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no second source could be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract document could be retrieved — web_search was unavailable during this run (searx connection refused) and the trade-data mirrors that would carry GST/turnover fields (volza, eximpedia, trademo) returned HTTP 403. What IS documented is the company's domestic commercial footprint as an importer-distributor: ImportKey lists 32 known trading partners and port lanes "KOLKATA SEA 3459 / KOLKATA ACC 2162 / Singapore 2083 / DUBAI WORLD CENTRAL 1057 / PARIS CHARLES DE G 793", and the registered address "VARDAAN, SUITE #403, 25A, CAMAC STREET" (Kolkata). This proves the company physically moves goods into India and clears them through Kolkata sea and air cargo, which implies onward domestic distribution, but no GST return, invoice, tender or contract line was seen. Domestic supply therefore remains declared/implied, not confirmed.
note: Role: importer/distributor of premium fragrances and cosmetics (Bentley, Nautica, Guess, Franck Olivier, Bulgari, Diptyque, Estee Lauder brands appear in its inbound entries) — a trader, not a manufacturer. HS mismatch flagged: declared HS 330499 (beauty/skin-care preparations) does not match the actual customs lines seen, which are 33030090 / 33030010 (perfumes and toilet waters) plus 39269099 (display/publicity material). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the factual 330300 (perfumery) family, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is imprecise: the goods are cosmetics/perfumery, adjacent to FMCG but not food. Export status is none_found: no export B/L with date, destination, HS code and B/L number exists in any source I could read; the company's documented trade is inbound only. Do not read the 46,041 platform counter as verified shipments — only 11 rows were actually visible. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reachable here, not estimated. CIN, PAN and state: null — no registry was consulted (registries out of scope) and none was claimed in the input.
